issues.description: The template's detect_errors function signature declares a return type of list[int], while the problem statement and the reference solution expect and use an npt.NDArray[np.int8] (a numpy array). This inconsistency in the annotated return type could confuse students about the expected return type and how to use the function (e.g., vectorized operations, dtype expectations).
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template function signature for detect_errors to return npt.NDArray[np.int8] (matching the problem statement and solution), and ensure the docstring and any tests refer to the numpy array type. Example: def detect_errors(measurements: npt.NDArray[np.int8], checks: npt.NDArray[np.int8]) -> npt.NDArray[np.int8]:
